description: This file defines the class BuzzPostDecorator, which implements a decorator pattern for the BuzzPost entity in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to set an Employee reference on a BuzzPost, utilizing traits and external entity classes.

classes.name: BuzzPostDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for BuzzPost entity, providing methods to manipulate BuzzPost objects with additional behavior.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a BuzzPost instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee with the BuzzPost using an employee number.
